title: Boston Gas Company files for review and approval a Firm Transportation Agreement with Salem State College.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating in the decision were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating and Judith F. Judson. (DTE 05-GC-4)
Replacement page to the filing that was received 4/8/05. By: Thomas P. O'Neill.
